youtubers.metaTitle: SEO Tools for YouTubers and Creators
youtubers.metaDescription: Free SEO tools for YouTubers and creators with a website: find keywords, generate titles, descriptions and scripts, and keep your site search-ready.
youtubers.headline: SEO tools for
youtubers.headlineAccent: YouTubers and creators with a website
youtubers.subheadline: Find keywords, write titles, descriptions and scripts, and keep your site search-ready, all from one free toolkit.
youtubers.pain1Body: Generate and check title options, and build structured descriptions with keywords and calls to action.
youtubers.pain2Title: Scripts start from a blank page
youtubers.pain2Body: Draft hooks, main points, transitions and CTAs before you record.
youtubers.pain3Title: Your website and channel grow separately
youtubers.pain3Body: Keep your site's metadata, speed and indexing healthy so your videos and pages can support each other.
youtubers.step1Body: Start with YouTube Keyword Ideas to find topics worth making.
youtubers.step2Body: Generate and check titles, then build the description and script.
youtubers.step3Body: Run the SEO Analyzer on the site or blog that supports your channel.
youtubers.closingBody: Pick a tool and run it in seconds. The tools are free to use.

bloggers.metaDescription: Free SEO tools for bloggers: analyze content, check keyword density, preview search snippets and generate schema markup before you publish.
bloggers.headline: SEO tools for
bloggers.subheadline: Check your content, balance keyword usage, preview your search snippet and add structured data before you publish.
bloggers.pain1Body: Analyze content length, readability, keywords and basic SEO quality signals in one pass.
bloggers.pain2Body: Review keyword frequency and keep your writing natural while staying on topic.
bloggers.pain3Title: Snippets and structured data are fiddly
bloggers.pain3Body: Preview how your page can look in search and generate JSON-LD markup you can paste in.
bloggers.step1Body: Run the Content Analyzer and Keyword Density Checker on your draft.
bloggers.step2Body: Write your title and description, then preview them in the SERP Snippet Preview.
bloggers.step3Body: Generate schema markup and test page speed before you hit publish.
bloggers.closingBody: Run your next post through the tools. They are free to use.

agencies.metaTitle: SEO Audit Tools for Agencies and Freelancers

agencies.headline: SEO audit tools for
agencies.subheadline: Audit client sites, check status codes, sitemaps and robots files, and save reports to your dashboard, without a heavy paid suite.
agencies.pain1Body: Run a website audit in one step and get clear recommendations to act on.
agencies.pain2Title: Technical checks are spread across tools
agencies.pain2Body: Status codes, sitemaps, robots files and schema markup, all in one toolkit.
agencies.pain3Title: Clients want something to look at
agencies.pain3Body: Create a free account to save reports to your dashboard and come back to them.
agencies.step1Body: Start with the SEO Analyzer to see technical, on-page and content signals.
agencies.step2Body: Check status codes, sitemaps and robots files for crawling and indexing problems.
agencies.step3Body: Use the generators for fixes, and save your reports to the dashboard.
agencies.closingBody: Run your first audit in seconds. The tools are free to use.
